reason: After the patch, `.d-header .panel` relies only on `margin-left: auto` (app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/header.scss:35-40) inside a `.contents` that the `flexbox()` mixin sets to `display: -webkit-box` for legacy engines (header.scss:17, common/foundation/mixins.scss:120-126), with the old `float: right` removed and no `-webkit-box-pack`/`box-flex` fallback anywhere in the mixins. The legacy-engine behaviour itself is not testable from the repo: I am relying on the known fact that the 2009 box model does not distribute free space to auto margins the way modern flexbox does, so the panel is not correctly right-aligned there.
